- Pricing for 250 seats (120 SDR / 130 AEs) with leader and admin accounts
- Migration path (sequence/rule export/import, cadence templates) and estimated timeline
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2, data retention, SSO + SCIM support)
- Any recommended contract language around data ownership and logging retention

I've attached the RFP we sent to other vendors. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a standard proposal template, and if you can provide a commercial ballpark by next Tues? Our sourcing lead Tom Rivera (cc'd) will manage procurement logistics.

Best,

Naomi / team — quick technical readout from my side:

- Sequence/Template export: Outreach offers CSV + JSON exports of sequences; Salesloft exports are more guarded but doable. Primary work is mapping custom fields and cadence triggers (time-of-day, skip rules).
- CRM sync: Two patterns: stop-gap parallel sync (both vendors syncing while we cutover) vs bulk migration (freeze writes for a weekend, migrate activity). For 250 seats I recommend parallel sync for 2 weeks then final cutover to avoid revenue risk.
- Integrations: ensure webhooks and activity objects map 1:1 (call, email, task). We should plan 6-8 engineering days for building import tooling and 10-12 services days for migration ops and QA (+ sprint for SF admin mapping).
- Data residency & logs: if they need extended audit retention beyond our default 13 months, we'll need a retention add-on.

I'll annotate the SOW with an appendix: migration timeline, acceptance criteria, rollback plan.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Principal Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — commercial snapshot below (ballpark, internal only). I'm also attaching a license-comparison-quote.xlsx with line items.

- List price (monthly seat): $55 SDR, $65 AE.
- 18-month commitment discount (for 250 seats): 25% off list + $30k onboarding credit.
- 36-month commitment discount: 35% off list + $20k migration services credit.
- Professional services: migration scoping & import tooling estimated at $48k (fixed) + $2.5k/day for on-site support if requested.
- Payment/Procurement: standard Net 30; for enterprise SOW we can accept Net 45 with a purchase order and signed SOW.

Questions from procurement I expect: PO flow, SOC 2 attestation, and the SSO/SCIM provisioning lead time (we can onboard Okta in ~5 business days after SCIM token exchange).

If we want to be competitive, offer a one-time seat credit (5% of total seats) if they sign within 30 days. I'll put both options in the quote.

-Marissa
